items.title: Update 0.4.8 is out
items.text: Night Ops and Daybreak, a full day and night cycle, dynamic weather, bots and servers for up to 64 players. You are already on it. Watch the trailer, then read everything that is new.

items.title: Three new Reborn servers
items.text: All Conquest Maps in three flavours, all with bots: Classic (24 players, the original look), Night Ops (32) and Daybreak (32).

items.title: Night Ops
items.text: A new kind of server for night battles, held at dusk. A storm builds as the tickets fall, and the buildings, lamps and headlights light the dark.

items.title: Daybreak
items.text: A new server type. The round starts as the sun rises, and the dynamic weather can bring rain or a storm as the battle goes on.

items.title: Day, night and the weather
items.text: A moving sun and its shadows, the moon and stars, clouds you can fly through, rain, fog, thunderstorms and the hurricane. On Night Ops servers and in Custom Matches.

items.title: 24, 32 or 64 players
items.text: 24 stays as the original, 32 is the new default and up to 64 for the biggest battles. Tickets scale with the size, and the scoreboard scrolls.

items.title: Bots fill the empty seats
items.text: Where a server's owner turns them on, bots take the free slots and give way when a player joins. They play the flags, drive tanks and show as BOT.

items.title: Custom Match, rebuilt
items.text: A page of its own with Match and Weather tabs: tickets, match time, bots, an ordered rotation, the time of day and the storm. Host online or on LAN.

items.title: The electric skin
items.text: A new skin for the Thompson and the Type 100: dark metal, gold wood, smoke and lightning. Unlock it by playing one full Night Ops match, then equip it from Unlockables.

items.title: Fly with your keys and mouse
items.text: Remap yaw, pitch and roll for planes in Settings, Controls, Bindings, Air vehicles, with a plane mouse sensitivity and invert options of their own.

items.title: Pings, sharp text, a new name page
items.text: Every player's ping on the scoreboard, a warning before a far away server, sharp menu text with Windows display scaling, and a new first start name page.

items.title: Choose your audio devices
items.text: Pick the device for game sound, chat output and chat input in Settings, Audio. Plus a Weather volume, and no more sounds cutting out on a busy PC.

items.title: Shadows, reflections, sharper HUD
items.text: Soft sun shadows, sea reflections, a high resolution HUD and a vehicle field of view. Some defaults change once with the update; you can set them back.

items.title: 60 ticks that feel like 30
items.text: Movement, jumping, swimming and recoil now behave at 60 ticks a second as they did at the original 30, and drawing is faster.

items.title: New tools for hosts
items.text: Server sizes, bots and tickets on each server's page, your own ban list, kicks and mutes, a Dashboard, an optional public community page and F9 for admins.

items.title: Join us on Discord
items.text: Find a squad, see when the servers fill up and tell us what you find in the playtest.
